# Psychology Today

> > Psychology Today is a comprehensive mental health and psychology resource covering therapy approaches, emotional wellness, relationships, and the biological foundations of human behavior.

The site provides evidence-based information on psychological topics ranging from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and therapeutic approaches to emotional intelligence, relationship dynamics, and the neurobiological underpinnings of behavior. It serves both professionals and the general public seeking understanding of mental health, human development, and interpersonal connections.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Relationships and human connection
- Emotions and emotional intelligence
- Sexual orientation and LGBTQ identity
- Family dynamics and sibling relationships
- Amygdala and prefrontal cortex
- Autonomic nervous system
- Aaron Beck and Albert Ellis
- Sex chromosomes (X and Y)
- Genetics and biological sex
- Therapeutic approaches
- Communication and relationship maintenance
- Mental health treatment
- Emotional fulfillment

## Core Psychology Topics

- [Emotions | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/emotions): Core topic page on emotions, decision-making, and emotional intelligence
- [Relationships | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/relationships): Core topic page on romantic relationships and human connection
- [Sexual Orientation | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/homosexuality): Core topic page on sexual orientation, LGBTQ identity, and coming out

## Therapy and Treatment Approaches

- [Cognitive Behavioral Therapy | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/therapy-types/cognitive-behavioral-therapy): CBT therapy guide covering Beck and Ellis methods for mental health treatment

## Family and Relationship Dynamics

- [The Sibling Relationship | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/family-dynamics/sibling-relationships): Guide on sibling relationships, family dynamics, and birth order effects

## Biological and Genetic Foundations

- [X Y Chromosomes | Psychology Today](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/basics/x-y-chromosomes): Reference guide on X and Y sex chromosomes, DNA, and biological sex
